summary.text: Johnny Chastain is a Republican state representative from Georgia House District 7 who has served since February 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He works in the banking industry.

paragraphs.text: Chastain was born in Georgia and lives in the state, and his career experience includes working in the banking industry.
Chastain succeeded the late David Ralston in District 7, assuming office on February 6, 2023, and advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.
For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the Banks and Banking Committee, the Natural Resources and Environment Committee, the Rural Development committee and the Small Business Development Committee.
